prompt:
Subject:
Pale green by the lifebuoy

Main Subject:
A full-body portrait of a young woman in a light mint-colored bikini and denim shorts standing leaning against a handrail on a wooden deck of an outdoor pool surrounded by tropical plants. The person is placed in the center of the screen, showing a thick tree and a red lifebuoy on the right, and the pool in the back left.

Person/Expression:
Small oval face tilted slightly to the right of the screen, looking straight ahead with large dark brown eyes. Thin eyebrows, small nose, and a calm expression with light coral lips slightly open. Light skin with pale pink cheeks. Long dark brown hair, nearly black, down to near the waist has a center-parted thin fringe, with large waves flowing in front of the chest on the left of the screen. Large silver hoop earrings.

Clothing/Pose:
Light mint-colored triangle bikini swimsuit with small scattered patterns. Thin neck strap, small metal fitting at the bottom center of the chest, bottom with black hip ties. Faded blue denim shorts with front button and zipper open, worn low to show the black swimsuit ties, with white frayed hems. Black thong sandals. Left arm bent overhead with the hand placed on top of the head, and the right hand on the metal handrail. Standing with legs crossed.

Background/Light:
Small light blue pool on the left, wooden deck, gazebo, and lounge chairs. Entire background filled with palms and dark green leaves. A thick bark tree on the right, a red and silver lifebuoy hung by a white rope, and a long metal handrail. Hard direct light and dappled sunlight from the top left fall in patches on the face, shoulders, abdomen, legs, and floor.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. The camera is at a horizontal perspective close to waist height, a full-body image capturing from the arm above the head to the sandals. The person is photographed at about three-quarters of the screen height, with the face in the top third, the waist in the center, and the crossed legs in the bottom center. The red lifebuoy is largely cropped on the right center, focusing on the person and the buoy.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic photo based on plant green, light blue, light mint, denim blue, and lifebuoy red. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, swimsuit fabric, frayed denim, tree bark, metal, and dappled sunlight.

Negative:
do not close the denim shorts worn low with the front open; do not omit the red lifebuoy
